name: CarTrade Tech Ltd
title: CarTrade Tech Ltd - 543333 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Strong FY26 profit (PAT ₹243 cr, up 68%) but OLX growth slowed to 16% in Q4; new Elite Buyer/Verification revenue still under 5% of OLX, so monetisation claims remain unproven.

triggers.label: OLX growth 16% in Q4
triggers.quote: for the quarter it's 16%, EBITDA 34% and profit after tax 44%

triggers.label: Elite Buyer under 5% of OLX revenue
triggers.quote: probably less than 5% last year for sure

triggers.label: No FY27 or OLX growth guidance given
triggers.quote: I don't want to give a guidance for this quarter or this year

triggers.label: Pricing static; growth from volume
triggers.quote: The pricing is pretty static. We mostly focus on volume increases

guidance.quote: one of the goals we've set ourselves is to get to approximately INR1,000 crores profit in the next four-five years
Yes, margin will expand this year

guidance.value: 2 to 3 years, subject to tax shelter rules
guidance.quote: I think maybe two to three years

prior_guidance_check.quote: Some of the initiatives like Verification was launched two months later than we thought.

red_flags.label: OLX growth decelerated to 16% in Q4 vs ~18% prior quarter
red_flags.quote: Again y -o-y growth has dipped, which is why I'm asking

red_flags.label: Repeated refusal to quantify OLX or FY27 outlook
red_flags.quote: I don't want to give a guidance for this quarter or this year

evasions.topic: OLX growth trajectory and April trends
evasions.quote: I don't want to give a guidance for this quarter either. So but directionally we would see.
I can't. As I said right now the revenue is just insignificant.
I don't want to comment and give you a guidance.
there's nothing at this point to report on a prospective M&A or utilization of cash
